framing: Retrospective backtest using only public information available pre-KRYSTAL-12 (Phase 3 NSCLC readout). Framework reproduces deal-range fair value from contemporaneous data; outcome (BMS $4.8B acquisition, Oct 2022) is the validation, not the prediction.

input_sources.peak_sales_usd_m: Pre-readout sell-side consensus implied $1.0-1.5B peak sales for adagrasib in 2L+ G12C NSCLC; conservative anchor at $1.2B reflects Mirati's smaller commercial footprint vs. Amgen's sotorasib. CRC/other-tumor expansion was potential upside, not in the base case.
input_sources.wacc: Phase 2 oncology mid-cap with BTD sits at the lower end of the wacc_benchmarks.json phase_2_small_mid_cap range (0.10-0.14). Using 10% reflects (a) the BTD-driven regulatory tailwind reducing late-stage uncertainty and (b) the typical sell-side practice of using lower discount rates when PoS already carries the development-stage risk weighting.
input_sources.competitors: Sotorasib (Lumakras) — only other approved/late-stage G12C inhibitor as of June 2022.
input_sources.regulatory_designations: FDA BTD granted for adagrasib in 2021 for NSCLC.
input_sources.biomarker_enrichment: KRAS G12C testing is a hard inclusion criterion — definitional biomarker enrichment.
input_sources.target_validated: Sotorasib received FDA accelerated approval May 2021 for the same target/indication — direct clinical validation.
input_sources.capital_position: Mirati had ~$890M cash at end of Q1 2022 and ongoing access to follow-ons; adequate but not 'well-capitalized'.

expected_outputs.verdict: Pre-readout (Phase 2, KRYSTAL-1 ongoing), framework values adagrasib at ~$545M as a risk-weighted entry point. Conditional on positive Phase 3 readout, framework value rises to ~$4.9B — bracketing the actual BMS $4.8B acquisition within ~2%. Story for a VC: pre-readout, you'd pay up to ~$550M; post-readout, the deal price is *exactly* defensible; the winner's-curse adjustment suggests a financial-buyer private value of ~$4.4-4.6B, so BMS's premium reflects strategic KRAS-franchise value, not financial fair value.
